page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.xlarge is an instance type belonging to the High Clock Speed ecs.hfg5 family, deployed on KVM virtualization. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Memory provisioning totals 16.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of system memory per allocated vCPU core.

Hardware resource allocation does not bundle any local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage volumes for persistent filesystem needs and operating system installations. Networking infrastructure provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. The instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and includes no GPU accelerators.

The 3.1 GHz dedicated processor frequency paired with a standard 1:4 memory allocation provides stable compute and throughput for workloads that demand steady single-thread performance without massive memory overheads. Cost efficiency stems from dedicated core execution combined with balanced resource sizing, avoiding idle memory overhead in compute-focused environments. Tradeoffs include reliance on networked storage for all disk I/O, which places dependence on network configuration for input-output tasks.

Typical workload profiles appropriate for Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.xlarge include general business web applications, API microservices, continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, and front-end transactional web servers requiring stable clock frequency.
